html:
Evo Morales was the president of Bolivia from 2006 to 2019, the first from the Indigenous majority. He was a leader of coca growers before entering politics.

Born to an Aymara family of llama herders, he moved to the Chapare and led its coca growers' unions against American-backed eradication. His party, the Movement for Socialism, rose with the protests of the water war and gas war, and he won the election of 2005.

He nationalised gas, used the money for social programmes, and cut poverty sharply. A new constitution in 2009 made Bolivia plurinational. He sought a fourth term despite losing a referendum on it, and after a disputed election in 2019 he resigned under pressure from the army and protests. He remains a powerful and divisive figure in Bolivia.
sum: Evo Morales was the president of Bolivia from 2006 to 2019, the first from the Indigenous majority. He was a leader of coca growers before entering politics.
